verdict.rationale: GrowthBook exposes a full REST API (growthbook-docs-12) and an MCP server that makes authenticated REST calls (growthbook-docs-21), which could in principle be scripted to act on many feature flags/experiments at once, but there is no documented bulk/batch endpoint or explicit bulk-operations feature. missing for 10: dedicated bulk-update/bulk-delete API endpoints, docs or examples showing multi-item batch operations, and independent confirmation that scripted bulk changes work in practice.
